title: Abstract Indefinite Problems in Riesz Spaces with Its Applications
summary: This paper investigates the existence of critical points for functionals defined on a Hilbert space $X$ which is continuously embedded into a Banach lattice $E$. A lattice decomposition of $E$ is constructed, which possesses both order disjointness and inner-product orthogonality. Accordingly, a corresponding decomposition of the Hilbert space $X$ is obtained. Under this decomposition, the associated functional satisfies the energy collapse condition and order-preserving property on certain subspaces, while exhibiting coerciveness on others.
